policy: No photography was generated, sourced externally, or modified in this redesign. Existing collection media retains its original files and content IDs.

opening.origin: Pre-existing owner-provided opening photograph; responsive variants hero/launch-800.webp, hero/launch-1600.webp, hero/launch-2400.webp already existed.

fonts.origin: Pre-existing self-hosted Calistoga font in the repository; newly enabled for gallery display typography.

icons: Interface controls use original authored SVG line geometry in index.html and js/atelier.js; no third-party icon library. Website favicon and Apple Touch Icon use the generated brand icon recorded below.

brandIcon.origin: Generated with the built-in image_gen tool for N1GHT CHXN9: cobalt enamel tile, ivory N monogram and crescent. No source photographs used.
brandIcon.processing: Pillow Lanczos downsampling; ICO includes 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256 pixel frames. Apple Touch Icon is flattened on #f8faff; other PNGs retain transparency. Existing night-mark assets preserved.

exports: PNG files are generated by the existing local Canvas workflows from the visitor's selected collection items.
